card.name: Large integer sets with unique triple sums

task.name: Large integer sets with unique triple sums
task.description: construct() -> 1..80 distinct positive integers <=n=4096. Every unordered triple, allowing repetitions, must have a different sum. Maximize cardinality. At most 80 positive integers in [1,4096], with all unordered triples including repetitions having unique sums. This is B_3[1], not the g>=2 improvement in the cited paper.
